name: Legacy Requests (obsolete parts)
one_liner: Models demand from government RFPs. And supply from 3P vendors on places like ebay and online auction houses.

steps.verb_object: lists the makes and parts government agencies keep filing to buy, each linked to the agency's own filing
flags the same buyer asking for the same part number again, months or years apart
'Find it': links a part to listings for sale (eBay, GovDeals, PublicSurplus), its manual, and who services it
hands a dealer every agency that filed for a model the dealer has listed (/for/<token>/ pages)

job_map.job: Find the part a customer needs
job_map.why: Links a part to eBay, GovDeals and PublicSurplus listings, but dealers' own sourcing channels are not evidenced.

job_map.job: Repair CNCs, PLCs, drives, motors, HMIs
job_map.why: The tool does no repair and does not connect repair demand to dealers.

job_map.job: Sell new, surplus and remanufactured stock
job_map.why: Lists agencies that filed for models the dealer has listed, but a Radwell reply showed no interest in a buyer report.

job_map.job: Get parts when the OEM no longer supports the equipment
job_map.why: Links to eBay and surplus listings, which they already search by hand; fabrication and patching are not covered.

job_map.job: Buy ahead of the OEM's legacy date
job_map.why: Shows which makes and parts other agencies keep filing for, but gives no OEM legacy dates.

job_map.job: Get failed drives repaired in an emergency
job_map.why: Links to who services a part, but emergency contracting is a procurement process the tool does not handle.

job_map.job: Refresh an obsolete radio dispatch system
job_map.why: A full system refresh is a major project, not part-level sourcing.
Repeat filings by the same agency are flagged, but the tool does not help with the replacement.

job_map.job: Reuse parts from retired vehicles on the remaining fleet
job_map.why: The agency harvests from its own decommissioned fleet; the tool does not support internal reuse.

job_map.job: Get approval to dispose of obsolete property
job_map.why: The tool shows demand and listings but does not support disposal approval.
Inventory write-off is not in the tool.

job_map.job: Report surplus and obsolete materials to the board
job_map.why: Reporting is not in the tool.
